text:
gaby: quick sync 1: customers hit billing surprises when SA requests are routed to shared pool projects. can we standardize telemetry so console and billing match?

owen: saw multiple tickets. console shows original sa but billing uses `pool-proj-*`. customers think someone else billed them.

lee: router only writes pool id to internal metrics stream. console query uses header `X-Consumer-SA` which is pre-routing. we should emit `X-Effective-Project` at decision time to the telemetry pipeline.

sam: Agree. But cardinality is a concern. Proposal: emit low-cardinality metric + sampled full event. Metric: `auth.routing.decisions_total{reason,is_fallback}`. Sampled event: `auth.routing.event` with compact fields. Add `routing_hash` for correlation.

gaby: UX request 1: console label should show both `Billed project` and `Acting SA`. small tooltip explains pooled billing and how to get pinned capacity.

owen: Private installs: do not send project IDs upstream. default for private is `aggregated` mode: counts only. add config `telemetry.routing_mode = "aggregated|detailed"`.

lee: sample event example (one-line): requested=sa:team-llm effective=proj-pool-9 reason=capacity_fallback routing_hash=ab12cd ts=2026-03-23T18:00Z sampled=true
gaby: rollout plan: feature flag `routing.telemetry.v3`, 5% of orgs internal first, SRE+CS 100%. console card behind flag.
sam: alerting: add a warning rule when fallback_rate(org,1h) > 0.005 -> notify triage channel. escalate if >0.01 for 1h.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: router-canary-4. CI green.

owen: I'll open PR for router header + metric emission. tagging @lee for telemetry schema.

lee: I'll add sampling + retention (30d) to pipeline PR and ensure routing_hash persists in logs for drilldown.
gaby: CS wants a one-paragraph explanation for the tooltip and a short runbook. I'll draft and post in #customer-success when PRs link.
sam: thanks. small follow-up: keep ids short (no emails), and ensure console drilldown uses `routing_hash` to avoid exposing project ids in URLs.
gaby: great. please drop PRs here and I'll coordinate CS copy. :thumbsup:
